provenance.purpose: Public declaration-only SQL parity fixture; contains no workspace data or bundle source.

needs.label: Your 200 most recently active tasks that belong to an epic: status, area, epic, counts, summary
needs.sql: WITH shared_records AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id, type, kind, name, lifecycle, summary, home_id, created_at, last_activity_at, deleted_at FROM records), shared_links AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT source_id, target_id, relationship FROM links), shared_areas AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT record_id, value FROM facet_values WHERE key = 'area') SELECT r.id, r.name, r.lifecycle, r.summary, (SELECT f.value FROM shared_areas f WHERE f.record_id = r.id) AS area, (SELECT e.id FROM shared_links l JOIN shared_records e ON e.id = l.target_id WHERE l.source_id = r.id AND l.relationship = 'part_of' AND e.kind = 'epic' ORDER BY e.id LIMIT 1) AS epic_id, (SELECT e.name FROM shared_links l JOIN shared_records e ON e.id = l.target_id WHERE l.source_id = r.id AND l.relationship = 'part_of' AND e.kind = 'epic' ORDER BY e.id LIMIT 1) AS epic_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shared_links l JOIN shared_records c ON c.id = l.source_id WHERE l.target_id = r.id AND l.relationship = 'part_of' AND c.kind = 'comment') AS comments, r.created_at, r.last_activity_at FROM shared_records r WHERE r.type = 'WorkItem' AND r.kind = 'task' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shared_links p JOIN shared_records e ON e.id = p.target_id WHERE p.source_id = r.id AND p.relationship = 'part_of' AND e.kind = 'epic') ORDER BY r.last_activity_at DESC, r.id LIMIT 200

needs.label: Epics with their folder and task counts
needs.sql: WITH shared_records AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id, type, kind, name, lifecycle, summary, home_id, created_at, last_activity_at, deleted_at FROM records), shared_links AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT source_id, target_id, relationship FROM links) SELECT e.id, e.name, e.lifecycle, (SELECT h.name FROM shared_records h WHERE h.id = e.home_id) AS folder, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shared_links l JOIN shared_records t ON t.id = l.source_id WHERE l.target_id = e.id AND l.relationship = 'part_of' AND t.kind = 'task' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL) AS tasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shared_links l JOIN shared_records t ON t.id = l.source_id WHERE l.target_id = e.id AND l.relationship = 'part_of' AND t.kind = 'task' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.lifecycle IN ('completed', 'closed')) AS done, e.created_at, e.last_activity_at FROM shared_records e WHERE e.type = 'WorkItem' AND e.kind = 'epic' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY e.last_activity_at DESC, e.id LIMIT 200

needs.label: Your 200 most recently active decisions with summary and link counts
needs.sql: WITH shared_records AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id, type, kind, name, lifecycle, summary, home_id, created_at, last_activity_at, deleted_at FROM records), shared_links AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT source_id, target_id, relationship FROM links) SELECT r.id, r.name, r.lifecycle, r.summary, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shared_links l JOIN shared_records t ON t.id = l.source_id WHERE l.target_id = r.id AND l.relationship = 'implements' AND t.kind = 'task') AS implemented_by, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shared_links l WHERE l.source_id = r.id OR l.target_id = r.id) AS link_count, r.created_at, r.last_activity_at FROM shared_records r WHERE r.type = 'Resolution' AND r.kind = 'decision' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.last_activity_at DESC, r.id LIMIT 200

needs.label: Which of those tasks depend on which other tasks
needs.sql: WITH shared_records AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id, type, kind, name, lifecycle, summary, home_id, created_at, last_activity_at, deleted_at FROM records), shared_links AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT source_id, target_id, relationship FROM links) SELECT l.source_id, l.target_id, t.name AS target_name FROM shared_links l JOIN shared_records t ON t.id = l.target_id WHERE l.relationship = 'depends_on' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.source_id IN (SELECT r.id FROM shared_records r WHERE r.type = 'WorkItem' AND r.kind = 'task' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shared_links p JOIN shared_records e ON e.id = p.target_id WHERE p.source_id = r.id AND p.relationship = 'part_of' AND e.kind = 'epic') ORDER BY r.last_activity_at DESC, r.id LIMIT 200) ORDER BY l.source_id, l.target_id LIMIT 200

needs.label: Complete selected record source and identity; NULL originals remain read-only
needs.sql: SELECT id, name, type, kind, body, length(body) AS body_length, 'full' AS body_source FROM records WHERE id = ?1 AND ((type = 'WorkItem' AND kind IN ('task', 'epic')) OR (type = 'Resolution' AND kind = 'decision')) AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

needs.label: Up to 200 task, epic or decision IDs eligible for title edits; exact input binding still required
needs.sql: SELECT r.id FROM records r WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((r.type = 'WorkItem' AND r.kind = 'epic') OR (r.type = 'Resolution' AND r.kind = 'decision') OR (r.type = 'WorkItem' AND r.kind = 'task' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM links l JOIN records e ON e.id = l.target_id WHERE l.source_id = r.id AND l.relationship = 'part_of' AND e.kind = 'epic'))) ORDER BY r.last_activity_at DESC, r.id LIMIT 200
